Instead, this file catalogs her guest appearances across host channels and conferences (Productized, Lenny's Podcast, Dan Olsen's Lean Product Meetup, Front, Hamel Husain, Product Faculty, Dovetail, Cieden, Userpilot, Mind the Product, Product Talk's own channel for short clips, and others), gathered via WebSearch across multiple query angles (keynotes, podcast interviews, opportunity-solution-tree talks, customer-interview talks, assumption-testing talks), starting from the study guide's known 211K-view Productized keynote. 29 unique candidate videos were found; metadata (views, likes, upload date) was pulled for all of them via yt-dlp `--dump-json` to rank by real view count rather than search-result order. One candidate (_Bx0ymjUy0U) was unavailable and dropped. Two more (a 45-second and an 85-second promotional clip, both under 100 views) were excluded as low-quality padding rather than substantial content, per this task's own guidance against padding with barely-relevant results. Transcripts were pulled via yt-dlp auto-captions (`--write-auto-sub --sub-format json3`), not Chrome video playback. Thumbnails were fetched via `img.youtube.com/vi/<id>/maxresdefault.jpg` (fallback `hqdefault.jpg`) and viewed directly. Because these are guest appearances, the video's actual opening ~15-30 seconds is often the host's introduction rather than Teresa Torres speaking; this is noted per entry.

creators.capture_method_label: Opened understandingai.org/archive in a dedicated Chrome tab, clicked the native "Top" sort control, and scrolled to lazy-load engagement-ranked posts. Recorded the top 30 posts as ranked by Substack's own "Top" sort (likes/comments/restacks as displayed on each archive card). For each post, opened the article page directly and extracted the verbatim opening hook, the promotional teaser/subtitle shown in the archive listing, and the full essay body text. Posts gated behind Substack's paid-subscriber paywall are marked PAYWALLED with the exact free-preview cut-off point noted; no gated content was guessed or fabricated.
Bluesky public AppView API (getAuthorFeed), ranked by visible likes; bounded to a recent-post window (last 245 non-repost original posts, spanning 2026-03-30 to 2026-08-06), not all-time
